dsDescriptionValue.value: A Lower limb bioheat COMSOL Multiphysics® (Massachusetts, USA) model. The model is based on the computed tomography dataset acquired from the Cancer Imaging Archives (Subject ID TGGA-CV-A6JU) [1,2,3] This COMSOL model simulates the peripheral thermal behavior using Pennes bioheat equation and by considering blood flow in the main arterial structure. [1] Zuley, M. L., Jarosz, R., Kirk, S., Lee, Y., Colen, R., Garcia, K., … Aredes, N. D. (2016). Radiology Data from The Cancer Genome Atlas Head-Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma [TCGA-HNSC] collection.
